transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I'm here because I've been struggling to cope and feeling really overwhelmed lately after a major change in my life. It's gotten to the point where I feel emotionally drained and can't seem to handle things normally anymore.
What major change happened, and when did your symptoms start in relation to it? Have the feelings mostly been tied to that change, or do they seem to persist more generally?

I'm not quite sure what specific major change might have triggered this, and I haven't really thought about it that way. I just know that I started feeling this overwhelmed about a week ago, and it has been pretty constant since then.

Did something traumatic or frightening happen right before this started, such as a serious accident, assault, or witnessing something life-threatening? Since it began, have you had nightmares, flashbacks, or felt unusually on edge because of it?

No, nothing traumatic like an accident or an assault happened to me. I also haven't had any nightmares or flashbacks about anything. It's just more of a constant, overwhelming feeling that I can't seem to shake.
Along with feeling overwhelmed, have you been feeling down or hopeless, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy? How has your sleep, appetite, and energy been over the past week?

Yes, I have been feeling really down and hopeless, with a very low mood over this past week. However, my sleep, appetite, and energy levels have been pretty normal, and I haven't really noticed any big changes there.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about many different things most days, even when there isn’t a clear reason, and has that been going on for at least 6 months?
No, I wouldn't say I've been worrying like that, and it definitely hasn't been going on for six months. This entire overwhelmed feeling only started about a week ago.
Over the past week, has this low mood caused clear problems in your work, school, or relationships, and have you also had trouble concentrating or felt worthless or guilty?

I have definitely been dealing with a very low mood for about a week now, which has made it harder to manage my daily routine and relationships. However, I haven't really noticed having those specific feelings of worthlessness, guilt, or trouble concentrating.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to die, hurt yourself, or that life isn’t worth living?
No, I haven't had any thoughts like that at all. I definitely don't want to hurt myself or die, even though I've been feeling really down.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy nearly every day since this started?

Yes, I really have. I've completely lost interest in the hobbies and activities I usually love, and it has felt that way almost every single day since this started. I just feel so down and sad all the time right now.
Have these symptoms—low mood and loss of interest nearly every day—lasted for at least 2 full weeks, or has it still been only about 1 week so far?
No, it hasn't been two full weeks yet. It has still only been about one week since I started feeling this way.
Even if it didn’t seem major at first, was there any specific life stressor or change—like a breakup, move, job problem, or family conflict—in the 3 months before this started?
Yes, actually. About a month ago, I went through a really difficult breakup and had to move into a new apartment. Looking back, that was definitely the major stressor that started all of this.
